articles.title: Bill Gates thinks policy like California’s 'rich tax' is only solution in AI age
articles.summary: Bill Gates emphasizes the necessity for governments to tackle inequality as AI creates wealth disparities. He believes that relying solely on philanthropy is insufficient to address growing economic inequality.

articles.title: Weeks after flydubai incident, 'hostile aircraft' alert triggers panic in Israel
articles.summary: An alert regarding a potential hostile aircraft intrusion in northern Israel was issued but later clarified. The alert prompted heightened scrutiny following an attempted hijacking of a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv.

articles.summary: A woman was found in Fargo after allegedly being chained to a bed for two years and abused. She was discovered after a maintenance worker heard her cries for help in the apartment complex.

articles.title: 10-year-old Ukrainian boy tracks rare black stork from Chernobyl to Africa to expose threats to its survival
articles.summary: Noah Beshto, a 10-year-old prodigy from Ukraine, embarked on an adventurous journey in a motorhome, tracking the migration of the black stork. Partnering with ornithologist Nika Paposhvili, he documented the hazards these birds face, such as electrocution and destruction of their habitats.

articles.title: Surat businessman gives employees Rs 1 lakh each as Diwali bonus; video goes viral
articles.summary: A video from Surat showing businessman Ramswaroop Munde, owner of Mahadev Cloth Centre in Mota Varachha, presenting his employees with Diwali bonuses has gone viral. Bundles of fresh notes were reportedly laid on puja thalis, with Rs 1 lakh each and Rs 20 lakh in total.

articles.title: ACC January 2027 entrance exam: NTA opens registration window; check exam schedule, fee and key details
articles.summary: The National Testing Agency has commenced the application process for the Common Entrance Examination for Army Cadet College. Interested candidates can apply online until November 30, 2026, with a late fee option available.

articles.title: Bhiwani girl secures AIR 15 in NDA, clears SSB in fourth attempt
articles.summary: Nineteen-year-old Parul Dahiya from Bhiwani district has secured All-India Rank 15 in the girls' category in the NDA examination, overcoming three unsuccessful SSB interview attempts before clearing the selection process on her fourth attempt. A BTech student and aspiring Indian Air Force officer, Parul credits persistence, improved preparation and a positive attitude for her success.

articles.title: RMS Class 9 Social Science syllabus 2026 revised; check official notice here
articles.summary: The National Testing Agency has announced a revised syllabus for the Class 9 RMS examination. Candidates are advised to refer to the updated syllabus available on the official NTA website.

articles.title: Isha Koppikar says 'Diwali is more than just burning crackers' amid Dia Mirza vs BMC row
articles.summary: Janhvi Kapoor opened up about her journey through nose surgery and how it transformed her mother's perspective. Initially, Sridevi had concerns about Janhvi pursuing an acting career due to the commitment it entailed.

articles.title: ‘Tyson Naidu’: Bellamkonda Sai Sreenivas and Neha Shetty dance to first single
articles.summary: Bellamkonda Sai Sreenivas will appear in the action entertainer 'Tyson Naidu', directed by Sagar K Chandra. The recently released single, 'Madarasi Rabbaru Bomma', features energetic dance moves by Sai Sreenivas and Neha Shetty.

articles.title: Keerthy Suresh compares Bollywood and South film industry work styles
articles.summary: Keerthy Suresh recently expressed her insights on the varying approaches between Bollywood and South Indian cinema. She observed that Bollywood generally emphasizes thorough pre-production and detailed actor preparation prior to filming.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 3 (LIVE)
articles.summary: Ramayana opened strongly at the box office, earning Rs 64.85 crore on its first day in India. The film experienced a slight decline on its second day, with Rs 48 crore net on Friday.
